# PDF complex-script test fonts

These SIL Open Font License 1.1 fonts are used only by PDF tests; they are not configured as production fallbacks. They are from the [Noto fonts repository](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts), commit `ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac`, under `hinted/ttf/`. See `OFL.txt`.

- `NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf`: SHA-256 `ceea25b464a656dc3b26849bab9356740401af62aedf1bfa8b7f0d9b75925b1b`
- `NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf`: SHA-256 `385e78e6359a9d88a0f243d53b1209d7548361ba2194e2b9ec779bcaa7e8949d`
